title: Warranty - Electronics
text:
This warranty covers TVs and headphones bought from our store, whether you ordered online or bought in person. TVs and headphones are covered for 1 year from the date of purchase against defects in materials and workmanship, with parts and labor included. The cover is the same for every screen size and every kind of headphones.

What the warranty covers

For a TV, the warranty covers the panel, the power supply, the speakers, the ports, the stand and the remote control that came in the box. Typical covered faults are a picture with dead pixels in a cluster, a screen that stays dark although the TV has power, ports that stop passing a signal, and a remote that stops working with fresh batteries. For headphones, it covers the speakers, the microphone, the controls, the battery and the charging case, so sound that drops out in one ear, or a case that no longer charges, is covered. Pixels that fail one at a time, rather than in a cluster, are reviewed case by case. Coverage applies to normal use in a home.

What the warranty does not cover

The warranty does not cover cracked or scratched screens, damage from drops, liquid or power surges, or normal wear such as worn ear cushions, ear tips and headbands. It does not cover image retention caused by showing the same still picture for long periods, apps and streaming services, or damage from mounting a TV with brackets that were not made for it. Faults caused by repairs made by anyone other than an approved service center are not covered either, and neither are headphones that were bent, crushed or sat on.

How to make a claim

To make a claim, contact our customer service team online or visit the service desk in one of our stores with your proof of purchase. Describe the fault and, if you can, send a photo or a short video that shows it. For a large TV, a technician can visit your home to look at it, or we collect it; headphones are sent to us with a prepaid label. The team may first guide you through a reset, because many faults clear after one. Keep a note of the claim number we give you and quote it whenever you contact us.

Repair, replacement or refund

If the claim is accepted, we repair the faulty part or replace the item with the same or a comparable one, and we choose which. Large TVs are usually repaired in your home, while headphones are usually replaced. A refund is offered only when neither repair nor replacement is possible. If a TV has to be taken away for repair, the technician brings a protective cover for the screen and returns the set when the work is done. Any part we fit is covered for the rest of the original warranty, not for a fresh period of its own.

Proof of purchase and transfer

Keep your proof of purchase for as long as the item is covered, because it shows when the cover started. If you bought online with your account, our team can find the sale there if the proof is lost. The warranty stays with the item if you give it away or sell it, and the next owner can make a claim with the original proof of purchase.
